summary: The Mexican airport operator filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, to update investors on recent developments, including its acquisition of Companhia de Participações em Concessões (CPC Aeroportos) in Brazil and the ASUR Airports, LLC (formerly URW Airports, LLC) purchase. No price per share, stake percentage, premium or closing date is disclosed in the excerpt. Management flags integration risk and additional minority-interest purchases tied to CPC Aeroportos. Watch for definitive terms, financing and regulatory approvals in Brazil as the deal-driven story develops.
